heading: **19 April 2026**
body:
*1.55X SELEX buffer*

*1.55x Promega Buffer, 155μM EGTA, 1.55mM DTT, 3μM ZnSO4 (no dIdC)*

250 mL

| Promega Buffer 1.55 (10X) | 38.75 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 77.5 uL |
| DTT (1 M) | 387.5 uL |
| ZnSO4 (100 mM) | 7.5 uL |

Make up the volume to 250 mL and filter the solution. Store at 4 degrees.  
Aliquot 8.5 uL of 1.55X SELEX Buffer per well of NUNC 384-well plates

*1X SELEX buffer*

*1x Promega Buffer, 100μM EGTA, 1mM DTT, 3μM ZnSO4 (no dIdC)*

250 mL

| Promega Buffer 1 (10X) | 25 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 50 uL |
| DTT (1 M) | 250 uL |
| ZnSO4 (100 mM) | 7.5 uL |

Make up the volume to 250 mL and filter the solution. Store at 4 degrees.

*TF Dilution*

Take 20 uL of protein per well \+ 75 uL TF Dilution Buffer

*Blocking Buffer Salt-free*

*Blocking buff (salt free): 25mM Tris, 0.5% BSA, 0.1% tween, 0.02% NaN3 pH8 \[500 mL buffer\]*

25 mM Tris pH 8 \= 12.5 mL  
0.5 % BSA \= 2.5 g BSA  
0.1 % Tween20 \= 500 uL  
0.02% NaN3 \= 0.1 g

500 mL

| Tris-HCl pH 8 | 12.5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| BSA | 2.5 g |
| Tween20 | 500 uL |
| NaN3 | 0.1 g |

*Elution Buffer*

0.1% Tween, 10 mM Tris pH7.8, 1 mM MgCl2 (0.5mM in PCR rxn)  
   
500 mL buffer:  
\-    	500 uL Tween20  
\-    	5 mL Tris pH 8  
\-    	500 uL 1M MgCl2

500 mL

| Tris-HCl pH 8 | 5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tween20 | 500 uL |
| MgCl2 (1 M) | 500 uL |
